hudify.midnightconfig.title: Hudify Config
Advanced options, change at your own risk!
hudify.midnightconfig.poll_rate.tooltip:
How often to send an API request to Spotify to refresh variables, in milliseconds.
WARNING: Too low a value can cause you to hit Spotify ratelimits!
hudify.midnightconfig.inactive_poll_rate:
How often to poll Spotify's API when the Spotify isn't running, in milliseconds.
This is how long it takes for Hudify to notice when you first start playing music.
For example, if you set this to 5000 ms, then start playing, you'll have up to a 5 second delay before Hudify displays anything
hudify.midnightconfig.scrub_name.tooltip:
*Currently unused*
If disabled, makes {sp_smartbrackets}, {sp_nobrackets} etc just return the track name without scrubbing anything.
Saves a tiny bit of processing power if you're not using the variable
hudify.midnightconfig.truncate_length.to:
Truncate long variables after this many characters.
Applies to artists, albums, and track names.
Set to -1 to never truncate.
hudify.midnightconfig.db.tooltip: Logs extra debug info. VERY spammy!
hudify.midnightconfig.db.label.tooltip: Logs extra debug info. VERY spammy!
hudify.midnightconfig.CLIENT_ID.tooltip: The client ID for your Spotify app. See readme
hudify.midnightconfig.CALLBACK_URI.toolt: The callback URI for your Spotify app. Note, Spotify no longer supports localhost as a URI. Don't touch this unless you know what you're doing. See readme.
hudify.midnightconfig.smartbrackets_kill: Removes 'featuring artist', 'with other artist', etc from the song title "smartbrackets" variables
